title: Health Day
description: One user's totals from the phone's health store for one local calendar day. The only health data the server holds. Every measurement is optional: an absent field means the health store had no data, never zero.

day.description: Local calendar day the totals belong to (YYYY-MM-DD)

tz.description: IANA time zone the day was cut in, e.g. Europe/Kyiv

platform.description: Which health store the totals came from

active_energy_kcal.description: Active energy burned during the day, in kilocalories

resting_hr_bpm.description: Resting heart rate for the day, in beats per minute

sleep_minutes.description: Minutes asleep in the night that ended on this day

weight_kg.description: Most recent body weight recorded on this day, in kilograms

external_workouts.description: Workouts in the health store that Aura Fit did not write

type.description: Kind of workout, normalised across both health stores
